root_cause: v3 added 5 OATP drugs are all FARTHER from posaconazole than existing nearest neighbors. NPE capacity allocated to new acid/OATP modes reduces calibration coverage in the already-OOD lipophilic-polar region where posaconazole lives. This is a capacity-reallocation regression, not a data-coverage improvement.
lesson_learned: Training expansion benefits in-domain drugs and can HURT already-OOD drugs if the added drugs are not closer in feature space. Pravastatin showed similar pattern (failed in v2, worsened in v3 — OATP drugs did not help it either).
recommended_action: NO CHANGE to production. v2 model (cov_dev 0.073) correctly routes posaconazole to SBI. If future training expansion is attempted, add structurally-similar high-logP/high-TPSA antifungals (itraconazole, voriconazole, ravuconazole) rather than unrelated drugs.
production_status: v2 model active, posaconazole→SBI route stable
